title: File:NASA Marshall visit to Super Heavy booster.jpg
desc: Starship launch hardware stands tall at SpaceX while NASA HLS experts, Randy Bresnik, and Victor Glover take a firsthand look. Engine mounts and wiring can be seen in this perspective. This is the first known image of an underside Super Heavy picture without engines.

title: File:Starship full stack with Jeep.jpg
desc: SpaceX's Starship (Starship SN20 and Super Heavy BN4) fully stacked at SpaceX Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas with a Jeep in the foreground for scale.

title: File:SpaceX Starship Superheavy Testing February 2023 (cropped horizontal).jpg
desc: SpaceX Starship's Superheavy Booster, serial no. B7, being tested on the orbital launch pad at Starbase, Boca Chica, Texas in February 2023.

title: File:Starship & Moonset.jpg
desc:
The moon sets behind the most powerful rocket ever constructed that will one day take humanity back to the moon and on to Mars.
Specifically, this is SpaceX's Starship SN20 sitting on top of Super Heavy BN4.
